fixes_applied.name: DataLoader parallelism
fixes_applied.notes: Eliminates data starvation on GPU; factor depends on disk/CPU speed

fixes_applied.name: Remove .item() from inner loop
fixes_applied.change: loss.item() moved from every step to every log_interval steps
fixes_applied.notes: Eliminates CPU-GPU sync barrier; most impactful on fast GPUs

fixes_applied.name: Automatic Mixed Precision
fixes_applied.notes: FP16 matmuls + GradScaler; Tensor Cores on GTX 1650 Ti give ~1.3-1.6x

fixes_applied.name: zero_grad set_to_none
fixes_applied.notes: Avoids memset of gradient buffers; minor but free

fixes_applied.name: TF32
fixes_applied.notes: Ampere+ Tensor Core format; GTX 1650 Ti (Turing) has limited benefit

fixes_applied.name: CUDA stream prefetcher
fixes_applied.change: CUDAPrefetcher wraps DataLoader to overlap H2D transfer with compute
fixes_applied.notes: Marginal on datasets that fit in RAM; larger benefit with large images

combined_estimated_speedup_description: Conservative estimate; 10-15h projected run now expected in 3-4h (vs 8+ days unoptimised)
fault_tolerance_additions: 30-min autosave daemon thread (atomic write to .tmp, then rename)
Resume from autosave.pt or controlled_last.pt via --resume-latest
Wall-clock segmentation: exit code 42 at max_wall_hours, relaunched by launch_segmented_training.py
Checkpoint retention policy: keep last 5 + every 10th epoch
